learning_outcomes.text: Explain the fundamental concepts, processes, and ecosystem of entrepreneurship and project management.
Develop a business idea within the framework of value proposition, business model canvas, and feasibility analysis.
Evaluate entrepreneurial opportunities by conducting market research, SWOT/PEST, and competitive analysis.
Prepare a project plan using project management methodologies (traditional, agile) and tools (WBS, Gantt, PERT/CPM).
Plan the project process by managing project risks, resources, budget, and stakeholders.
Present, report, and effectively communicate an entrepreneurship/project idea individually or in teams to stakeholders.

syllabus_topics: Basic concepts of entrepreneurship, characteristics of the entrepreneur, and essential skills
Types of entrepreneurship, entrepreneurial culture, motivation, and family business
Examples of successful and unsuccessful entrepreneurship
Organizational culture, communication and entrepreneurship networks, entrepreneurship and franchising
Local entrepreneurship, can everyone be an entrepreneur?
The concept of the business plan and its elements (market research, marketing plan, production plan, management plan, financial plan), examples of business plans
Definition, characteristics, and classification of the project
Control and reporting in project management
Case examples (business plan presentations, results, and discussion)
